title: Async state coverage
summary: Any user-visible async/API flow must account for loading, error, and empty states or record a scoped waiver.

title: Single env owner
summary: New configuration/env variables should be read from one owner module and passed inward.

title: Webhook delivery contract
summary: Webhook handlers should prove signature/secret verification plus idempotency or retry semantics.

title: Migration journey proof
summary: Migration/backfill/import paths should include a dry-run, rollback, checkpoint, or before/after journey test.
